messages:
Evan Stone: Heads-up — Meridian Analytics (acct MA-907) invoice INV-2026-134 for $12,450 is 33 days past due. They emailed asking for a split-pay and to waive late fees due to a bank delay.
Priya Shah: Policy: we can approve up to 60 days with initial >=30%. Waive late fee at manager discretion.
Jules - CS: Customer on the line says their AR was delayed by a corporate payment run; they can pay 35% now and the rest over two months. They asked if we can redact internal job ids on the invoice.
Mark (Billing): Proposed plan: 35% now ($4,357.50) due 2025-12-02, 32.5% ($4,046.25) due 2026-01-02, 32.5% ($4,046.25) due 2026-02-02. Waive current late fee if initial payment clears. Will send DocuSign agreement.
collections-bot: Dunning notice #4 sent at 1972000300. Auto-suspend paused for 72h while agreement in flight.
Priya Shah: Approve the plan and late-fee waiver contingent on signed agreement and initial payment clearing within 72 hours of DocuSign. Document "one-time courtesy" in the account note.
Evan Stone: Agreed. Jules, get the customer to sign and wire with reference INV-2026-134 / MA-907. Mark, update ledger when cleared.
Mark (Billing): DocuSign sent -> viewed at 1972000600. I redacted job ids on invoice. Reminder scheduled to verify payment on 2025-12-03.
collections-bot: Reminder scheduled: verify-initial-payment on 2025-12-03.
Evan Stone: If initial payment fails, resume suspension and escalate to Legal.
